plot.title: Register and configure my plot
plot.description: Create a plot, enter its details and delineate the land.
plot.keywords: plot land map area location registration
plot.objective: You will finish with a plot ready for monitoring and the other modules.
plot.tip: Mark the perimeter by walking the land or selecting its corners on the map.

0.title: Open My Plots
0.description: Open My Plot and select View all plots to see the available slots in your plan.

1.title: Enter the general details
1.description: Provide the name, region, crop, variety, sowing date and estimated area.

2.title: Delineate the land
2.description: Mark at least three corners on the map to form a perimeter without crossing sides.

3.title: Save and select the plot
3.description: Confirm registration and select the plot for the dashboard, crop health and alerts.

health.title: Using the Crop Health tool
health.description: Review vegetation vigor, observations and possible stress areas.
health.keywords: health ndvi satellite stress crop monitoring
health.objective: Learn to interpret monitoring data without treating it as an agronomic diagnosis.
health.tip: NDVI is a supporting signal. Report visible symptoms so an advisor can review them.

0.title: Select the plot
0.description: Use the top selector to choose the plot you want to inspect.

1.title: Review the latest observation
1.description: Check its capture date, vegetation vigor and recorded stress area.

2.title: Observe the trend
2.description: Compare available observations to identify changes during the season.

3.title: Ask for help when needed
3.description: If you see symptoms or a large decline, consult the advisor and describe your findings.

expenses.title: Expense and earnings management
expenses.description: Record costs and calculate the minimum price needed to recover your investment.
expenses.keywords: expenses sales costs inputs labor freight earnings
expenses.objective: Keep the campaign cost and breakeven point up to date.
expenses.tip: Record expenses on the same day to avoid omissions and preserve accurate dates.

0.title: Choose a plot with a campaign
0.description: Expenses are organized by plot and agricultural campaign.

1.title: Select the expense type
1.description: Record inputs, labor, transport or freight.

2.title: Enter the amount
2.description: Provide the description, quantity, price or daily wage and its date.

3.title: Review the summary
3.description: Check total investment, cost distribution and the estimated breakeven price.

advisor.title: Consulting advisors: best practices
advisor.description: Submit a clear report to receive technical guidance.
advisor.keywords: advisor agronomist pest disease consultation report photo
advisor.objective: Prepare useful reports that support a responsible technical recommendation.
advisor.tip: Do not apply products based only on an image; wait for the professional assessment and prescription.

0.title: Describe the symptoms
0.description: Explain what you see, when it started and where it appears on the crop.

1.title: Indicate severity
1.description: Choose a level that reflects the extent and damage you observe.

2.title: Attach clear evidence
2.description: If you have a photo, ensure it is focused and shows the affected plant parts.

3.title: Follow the report
3.description: Check whether it is pending, inspected or resolved and review the issued prescription.

alerts.title: Understanding agricultural alerts
alerts.description: Address weather and phytosanitary risks through an ordered plan.
alerts.keywords: alert frost rain drought weevil risk timeline tasks
alerts.objective: Understand the difference between reading a notification and addressing its risk.
alerts.tip: Complete measures in order; the plan can only finish after all of them are confirmed.

0.title: Select the plot
0.description: Alerts are filtered using the region of the selected plot.

1.title: Review severity
1.description: Read the source, latest update and risk level before acting.

2.title: Open the action plan
2.description: Select View action plan to see the recommended measures.

3.title: Confirm measures in order
3.description: Perform and confirm each activity. Progress updates automatically.

4.title: Review the timeline
4.description: Check operating times and milestones to identify the current task.

5.title: Finalize and review the report
5.description: At 100% progress, finalize the plan and keep its implementation summary.

certificates.title: Harvest certificates
certificates.description: Review and share origin and quality documents.
certificates.keywords: certificate harvest quality origin qr buyer
certificates.objective: Learn how to review and present a verifiable harvest certificate.
certificates.tip: The buyer can scan the QR code to verify the document publicly.

3.title: Download or open the public record
3.description: Save the document or share its public verification link.
